primary_headings.usage: Act I conviction statements, major section transitions, cinematic hero titles.

monospace.usage: Labels, metrics, evidence room data, diagrams, UI annotations.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_jacking: Use useScroll and useTransform to create a sticky 'film' experience for Act III.
motion_and_interactions.dialog_animation: Dialog boxes over the laptop must use spring physics: { type: 'spring', damping: 20, stiffness: 100 }. They should fade and scale up (opacity 0 -> 1, scale 0.95 -> 1) dynamically based on scroll progress.
motion_and_interactions.line_callouts: Use SVG paths with pathLength animated via Framer Motion to draw lines from dialog boxes to specific UI elements on the laptop.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap heavy animations in a check for prefers-reduced-motion. Provide a fallback static layout for mobile/reduced-motion users.

five_act_structure.description: Fullscreen cinematic hero. Dark mode, stark white Playfair Display typography. Slow fade-ins. Text: 'Intelligence is abundant. Coordination is scarce.'
five_act_structure.layout: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-center px-4

five_act_structure.description: Animated visual mode showing agent multiplication and coordination debt. Use an SVG-based network graph where nodes multiply and connections become tangled. No fake metrics, just visual metaphor.
five_act_structure.layout: py-32 container mx-auto grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-16 items-center

five_act_structure.act: Act III: The Product Proof (The Core)
five_act_structure.description: A massive sticky-scroll section. A beautifully rendered CSS/SVG MacBook Pro scales up to the center of the screen. As the user scrolls down, the screen stays sticky. Scroll progress triggers 9 distinct feature dialog boxes appearing sequentially over the laptop. Each dialog has an SVG line pointing to a UI element inside the screen.
five_act_structure.layout: h-[500vh] relative. Inside, a sticky top-0 h-screen flex items-center justify-center.

five_act_structure.description: Compact architectural diagrams. No repetitive 3-column cards. Use an asymmetric 'Bento' grid with 1px borders, dense data, and JetBrains Mono for system components.
five_act_structure.layout: py-32 container mx-auto. Grid layout with tight gaps (gap-4). Surfaces are transparent with crisp white/gray borders.

five_act_structure.description: Due diligence tabular view. Monospaced. Modeled scenarios must clearly be marked 'MOCKED' or 'MODELED'. Include Built/Modeled/Next states and risk awareness. Ends with a severe, high-contrast investor CTA.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use the dark textured background (e.g., Unsplash plaster) at 10% opacity over the black background to remove the 'flat' digital feel. Use mix-blend-overlay.
visual_enhancers.borders: Strict 1px solid #27272a. No soft shadows. Hard lines.
visual_enhancers.glows: Prohibited. No orb glowing gradients. Keep it enterprise, sharp, and realistic.

components_needed: FeatureDialogBox (Act III subcomponent with SVG line)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: All interactive elements, dialogs, and sections must have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='investor-hero', data-testid='feature-dialog-1').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text, especially inside the product demo UI.

image_urls.macbook_screen_mockup: Code-generated UI preferred to keep it crisp. No external laptop images needed if built via CSS.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not build standard SaaS landing pages with huge padding and 3-column feature grids. This must feel like an editorial film or a high-end data room.
For Act III, use Framer Motion's useScroll with a target ref. Map the scrollYProgress to step indexes (0 to 8) to sequentially reveal the 9 dialog boxes.
Ensure dialog boxes physically overlap the laptop visual. Use absolute positioning inside a relative container.
Keep typography severely minimal outside the product demo. Playfair Display for big statements, JetBrains Mono for data.
Every metric in the Evidence Room MUST have a tag that says [MODELED] or [MOCKED] to abide by the user's strict rules.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Always use modern button styles, pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
